name: A Dream Scented in Wheat
description: Critical threshold −1. Ultimate and follow-up hits deal +2 damage.

name: A Grounded Ascent
description: Supporting one ally with a Skill or Ultimate grants that ally Hymn: +1 damage per stack, maximum 3, for 3 turns. Gain 2 Energy per qualifying use; every second use restores 1 SP.

name: A Secret Vow
description: Deal +2 damage. Add another +2 against enemies whose current HP percentage is at least yours.

name: A Thankless Coronation
description: Critical damage bonus +4. After your Ultimate, attack bonus +2 for 2 turns. If maximum Energy is at least 60, gain 3 Energy and another +1 attack bonus.

name: A Trail of Bygone Blood
description: Critical threshold −1. Skill and Ultimate hits deal +2 damage.

name: Adversarial
description: Defeating an enemy grants +10 feet speed for 2 turns; refresh duration, do not stack.

name: After the Charmony Fall
description: Break Effect score +2. After your Ultimate, speed +10 feet for 2 turns.

name: Along the Passing Shore
description: Critical damage bonus +4. A hit marks its target until your next turn. Your subsequent hits against that target deal +2 damage, or +3 for an Ultimate.

name: Amber
description: AC +1. While below half maximum HP, gain another +1 AC.

name: An Instant Before A Gaze
description: Critical damage bonus +4. Ultimate hits gain +1 damage per 20 maximum Energy, capped at +3.

name: Arrows
description: Critical threshold −1 for your first 3 turns in combat.

name: Baptism of Pure Thought
description: Critical damage bonus +4, plus +1 per distinct enemy debuff, capped at +3. After your Ultimate, deal +2 damage and your follow-ups gain +2 additional damage for 2 turns.

name: Before Dawn
description: Critical damage bonus +4. Skill and Ultimate hits deal +2 damage. Using either stores one charge; your next follow-up consumes it for +3 damage.

name: Before the Tutorial Mission Starts
description: Effect Hit bonus +1. Hitting an enemy with reduced AC restores 2 Energy, once per turn.

name: Boundless Choreo
description: Critical threshold −1. Critical damage bonus +3 against targets with an active tracked Reduced AC or Slowed effect. The GM can assign either marker; mental adjustments are never inferred.

name: Brighter Than the Sun
description: Critical threshold −1. Each completed Basic grants one Dragon stack, maximum 2. Each stack lasts 2 wearer turns and grants attack bonus +1 and Energy Regeneration score +1. Display stacks and expiry in the GM panel; expire each independently.

name: But the Battle Isn't Over
description: Energy Regeneration score +2. Every second support Ultimate restores 1 SP. After your Skill, the next ally to take a turn gains +2 damage for that turn.

name: Carve the Moon, Weave the Clouds
description: At combat start and your turn start, randomly grant the party attack bonus +1, critical damage bonus +2, or Energy Regeneration score +1 until your next turn. Do not repeat the previous result. Ends if you fall unconscious.

name: Chorus
description: Party attack bonus +1 while you are conscious in combat. Multiple Chorus effects do not stack.

name: Collapsing Sky
description: Basic and Skill hits deal +1 damage.

name: Concert for Two
description: AC +1. Deal +1 damage per ally with temporary HP, capped at +3.

name: Cornucopia
description: Skill and Ultimate healing restore +2 HP per recipient.

name: Cruising in the Stellar Sea
description: Critical threshold −1, improving to −2 against enemies below half HP. Defeating an enemy grants attack bonus +2 for 2 turns.

name: Dance at Sunset
description: Critical damage bonus +4. Your Ultimate grants Firedance, maximum 2 stacks: follow-up damage +2 per stack for 2 turns. Once per turn, a hit can provoke the target until your next turn.

name: Dance! Dance! Dance!
description: Your Ultimate grants each ally +2 initiative for the next round, once per combat. This changes turn order; it does not grant another turn.

name: Darting Arrow
description: Defeating an enemy grants attack bonus +1 for 3 turns.

name: Data Bank
description: Ultimate hits deal +2 damage.

name: Day One of My New Life
description: AC +1. Conscious allies reduce incoming damage by 1 per hit. Multiple copies do not stack.

name: Dazzled by a Flowery World
description: Critical damage bonus +4. Party SP capacity +1 per Elation ally, capped at +3. Spending SP adds +1 Elation damage per charge, capped at +4, until your next turn. Spending 4 SP in one turn grants party Elation damage +2 for 1 turn.

name: Defense
description: Your Ultimate restores 3 HP to you, once per turn.

name: Destiny's Threads Forewoven
description: Saving throws +1. Deal +1 damage for every 2 AC above 10, capped at +3.

name: Dream's Montage
description: Speed +5 feet. Hitting a target whose current toughness is exactly 0 restores 2 Energy, once per turn. Check toughness when the hit resolves.

name: Dreamville Adventure
description: Your most recent Basic, Skill, or Ultimate grants allies +2 damage with that same ability category until you use another category. Does not stack with another copy.

name: Earthly Escapade
description: Critical damage bonus +4. Party Mask grants critical threshold −1 and critical damage bonus +2 for 3 turns at combat start. After restoring 4 total SP, refresh Mask for 4 turns and reset the counter.

name: Echoes of the Coffin
description: Attack bonus +2. An attack restores 1 Energy per distinct target hit, capped at 3 per turn. Your Ultimate grants party speed +10 feet for 1 turn.

name: Elation Brimming With Blessings
description: Attack bonus +2. A Skill or Ultimate supporting an ally grants them Elation damage +3 for 2 turns.

name: Epoch Etched in Golden Blood
description: Attack bonus +2. An attacking Ultimate restores 1 SP, once per turn. A supporting Skill grants its target Skill damage +3 for 3 turns.

name: Eternal Calculus
description: Attack bonus +1. After an attack, gain +1 attack bonus per distinct target hit, capped at +3, for your next attack. Hitting at least 3 enemies also grants speed +10 feet for 1 turn.

name: Eyes of the Prey
description: Effect Hit bonus +1. DoTs applied by you increase one die step: d4 → d6 → d8 → d10 → d12. No flat DoT damage bonus.

name: Fermata
description: Break Effect score +2. Direct hits against Shock or Wind Shear targets deal +2 damage. Your Shock and Wind Shear DoTs gain +1 turn when applied.

name: Final Victor
description: Attack bonus +1. Critical hits grant critical damage bonus +1 per stack, maximum 4, expiring at the end of your turn. The triggering critical uses only previously earned stacks.

name: Fine Fruit
description: At combat start, restore 3 Energy to every ally, once per combat.

name: Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path
description: Maximum HP +8 and incoming healing +2. A Skill or Ultimate may cost 2 HP for +2 damage, or 4 HP for +4 damage. This cannot reduce you below 1 HP.

name: Flames Afar
description: Losing or spending more than one quarter of maximum HP in one event restores 3 HP and grants damage +2 for 2 turns. Three-turn cooldown.

name: Flowing Nightglow
description: An ally's attack grants you Energy Regeneration score +1 per stack, capped at 5. Your Ultimate consumes all stacks to grant you attack bonus +2 and party damage +2 until your next turn.

name: Fly Into a Pink Tomorrow
description: Critical damage bonus +2. If attuned by the configured Trailblazer actor, grant party damage +1 and that actor's enhanced Basic damage +3.

name: For Tomorrow's Journey
description: Attack bonus +1. After your Ultimate, deal +2 damage until the end of your next turn.

name: Geniuses' Greetings
description: Attack bonus +1. Your Ultimate grants you and your memosprite Basic damage +2 for 3 turns.

name: Geniuses' Repose
description: Attack bonus +1. Defeating an enemy grants critical damage bonus +3 for 3 turns.

name: Good Night and Sleep Well
description: Direct hits deal +1 damage per distinct tracked debuff, capped at +3. Your DoTs gain one die step against targets with at least 2 distinct tracked debuffs, recalculated each tick; cap d12.

name: Hey, Over Here
description: Maximum HP +5. Your Skill grants outgoing healing +2 for 2 turns.

name: Hidden Shadow
description: Your Skill charges your next Basic hit to deal +2 damage. One stored charge; repeated Skills refresh it.

name: Holiday Thermae Escapade
description: Deal +1 damage. A hit forces a Constitution save; on failure, that target takes +1 damage from each qualifying allied hit for 2 turns. No duplicate stacking.

name: I Shall Be My Own Sword
description: Critical damage bonus +4. When another ally is hit or loses HP, gain Eclipse, capped at 3. Your next attack consumes all stacks for +1 damage each; consuming 3 adds another +2 damage.

name: I Venture Forth to Hunt
description: Critical threshold −1. Follow-ups grant Luminflux, maximum 2 stacks. Your Ultimate consumes the stacks for +2 damage each. Lose one stack at your turn end.

name: If Time Were a Flower
description: Critical damage bonus +4. A follow-up restores 2 Energy and grants party critical damage bonus +2 for 2 turns, once per turn. Start combat with 3 Energy and that party buff.

name: In Pursuit of the Wind
description: Party Break damage +2 while you are conscious in combat. Multiple copies do not stack.

name: In the Name of the World
description: Deal +2 damage against debuffed enemies. Your Skill gains attack bonus +1 and Effect Hit bonus +1.

name: In the Night
description: Critical threshold −1. Per 10 feet of speed above 30, gain Basic and Skill damage +1 and Ultimate critical damage bonus +1, capped at 3 steps.

name: Incessant Rain
description: Effect Hit bonus +2. Critical threshold −1 against enemies with at least 3 debuffs. Once per turn, a hit marks one target with Aether Code for 1 turn: allied hits against it deal +1 damage.

name: Indelible Promise
description: Break Effect score +2. Your Ultimate grants critical threshold −1 for 2 turns.

name: Inherently Unjust Destiny
description: AC +2. Granting an ally temporary HP gives you critical damage bonus +3 for 2 turns. Your follow-up forces a Constitution save; on failure, the target takes +1 allied hit damage for 2 turns.

name: Into the Unreachable Veil
description: Critical threshold −1. Your Ultimate grants Skill and Ultimate damage +3 for 3 turns. Spending at least 50 Energy on it also restores 1 SP.

name: It's Showtime
description: Applying a debuff grants damage +1 per stack, maximum 3, until your next turn. With an Effect Hit bonus of at least +3, also gain attack bonus +1.

name: Journey, Forever Peaceful
description: Temporary HP you grant increases by 3. Allies currently protected by your cone-enhanced temporary HP deal +1 damage.

name: Landau's Choice
description: Reduce incoming damage by 1 per hit. Once per turn, hitting an enemy can provoke it until your next turn.

name: Lies Dance on the Breeze
description: Speed +10 feet. After your attack, each target hit makes a Constitution save; failure reduces AC by 1 for 2 turns. At speed 50 feet or higher, reduce AC by 2 instead. No duplicate stacking.

name: Life Should Be Cast to Flames
description: Restore 2 Energy at your turn start. Deal +2 damage against enemies with an implanted weakness. Once per turn, a hit forces a Constitution save; failure gives AC −1 for 2 turns.

name: Lingering Tear
description: At 10 or more Punchline, critical damage bonus +2.

name: Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky
description: Speed +10 feet. After a consenting ally spends HP, your next memosprite attack deals +3 damage. Its Skill forces a Constitution save; failure grants allied direct-hit damage +1 for 2 turns. No DoT bonus.

name: Long Road Leads Home
description: Break Effect score +2. Whenever an ally Breaks an enemy, that enemy gains Charring: +1 Break damage taken per stack, capped at 2, for 2 turns.

name: Loop
description: Direct hits deal +2 damage against targets with an active tracked Slowed marker. This is the module's speed-reduction effect, not a built-in D&D condition.

name: Make Farewells More Beautiful
description: Maximum HP +8. Losing HP during your turn grants you and your memosprite damage +2 for 2 turns. When the memosprite disappears, gain +2 initiative next round, once per Ultimate cycle.

name: Make the World Clamor
description: Start combat with 5 additional Energy. Ultimate damage +2.

name: Mediation
description: At combat start, grant party speed +10 feet for 1 turn. Multiple copies do not stack.

name: Memories of the Past
description: Break Effect score +2. An attack restores 2 Energy, once per turn.

name: Memory's Curtain Never Falls
description: Speed +10 feet. Your Skill grants party damage +2 for 3 turns.

name: Meshing Cogs
description: Attacking or being hit restores 2 Energy. Combined limit: once per turn.

name: Moment of Victory
description: AC +2 and Effect Hit bonus +1. Being hit grants another +1 AC until your next turn. Once per turn, a hit can provoke the target until your next turn.

name: Multiplication
description: After a Basic attack, gain +1 initiative for the next round, once per round. This grants no additional turn.

name: Mushy Shroomy's Adventures
description: Elation damage +2. Your Elation Skill forces each target to make a Constitution save; failure gives Elation damage taken +2 for 2 turns.

name: Mutual Demise
description: While below 80% maximum HP, critical threshold −1.

name: Never Forget Her Flame
description: Break Effect score +3. Your Breaks and those of the configured Break partner deal +2 damage. Implanting a weakness restores 1 SP, once per Ultimate cycle. Default partner: conscious ally with highest Break Effect.

name: Night of Fright
description: Energy Regeneration score +2. An ally's Ultimate heals the lowest-HP-percentage ally for 3 HP, once per round. Your healing grants its recipient attack bonus +1 per stack, maximum 3, for 2 turns.

name: Night on the Milky Way
description: Attack bonus +1 per enemy in combat, capped at +3. Any allied Break grants you damage +2 until your next turn.

name: Ninja Record: Sound Hunt
description: Maximum HP +5. Losing or recovering HP grants critical damage bonus +3 for 2 turns, once per turn.

name: Ninjutsu Inscription: Dazzling Evilbreaker
description: Break Effect score +3. Start combat with 5 Energy. Your Ultimate grants 2 Raiton charges; each Basic consumes one for +2 initiative next round, limited to one advancement per round.

name: Nowhere to Run
description: Attack bonus +1. Defeating an enemy restores 3 HP to you, once per turn.

name: On the Fall of an Aeon
description: Each attack grants attack bonus +1, capped at +3 for the combat. Breaking an enemy grants damage +2 for 2 turns.

name: Only Silence Remains
description: Attack bonus +1. While at most 2 enemies remain in combat, critical threshold −1.

name: Passkey
description: Your Skill restores 2 Energy, once per turn.

name: Past Self in Mirror
description: Break Effect score +3. Your Ultimate grants party damage +2 for 3 turns; with Break Effect bonus at least +3, also restore 1 SP. Start combat with 3 Energy for every ally.

name: Past and Future
description: Your Skill grants the next ally to take a turn damage +2 for that turn.

name: Patience Is All You Need
description: Direct-hit damage +2. Attacks grant tracked speed +5 feet per stack, capped at +15 feet for combat. Once per turn, a hit forces a Constitution save; failure applies Shock: 1d4 Lightning damage for 1 target turn.

name: Perfect Timing
description: Saving throws +1. Outgoing healing gains +1 per point of your total saving-throw item bonus, capped at +3.

name: Pioneering
description: Breaking an enemy restores 3 HP to you, once per turn.

name: Planetary Rendezvous
description: Allies sharing your configured damage element gain damage +1 with that element. Multiple copies do not stack.

name: Poised to Bloom
description: Attack bonus +1. If at least two allies share a Path, those allies gain critical damage bonus +2. Multiple copies do not stack.

name: Post-Op Conversation
description: Energy Regeneration score +2. Ultimate healing restores +2 HP per recipient.

name: Quid Pro Quo
description: At your turn start, restore 3 Energy to one random other conscious ally below half Energy. Once per turn.

name: Reforged Remembrance
description: Effect Hit bonus +2. Hits against tracked Burn, Shock, Bleed, or Wind Shear grant one Prophet stack per distinct type, maximum 4 per combat. Each stack grants attack bonus +1. At 4, your DoTs gain one die step, recalculated each tick; cap d12.

name: Reforged in Hellfire
description: Maximum HP +8. Gain 5 Energy at your first combat turn. Your Skill marks its target for 2 turns: allied critical damage against it gains +2, and your own critical damage gains another +2.

name: Reminiscence
description: Each memosprite turn grants you and it damage +1, capped at +3. Reset when it leaves the battlefield.

name: Resolution Shines As Pearls of Sweat
description: Once per turn, a hit forces a Constitution save. Failure applies Ensnared: AC −1 until the end of its next turn. Refreshes, does not stack.

name: Return to Darkness
description: Critical threshold −1. Once per turn, a critical hit may remove one removable beneficial effect if the target fails a Constitution save.

name: River Flows in Spring
description: Speed +5 feet and damage +1. Taking damage suppresses both until the end of your next turn.

name: Sagacity
description: Your Ultimate grants attack bonus +1 for 2 turns.

name: Sailing Towards A Second Life
description: Break Effect score +3 and Break damage +2. With total Break Effect bonus at least +3, speed +10 feet.

name: Scent Alone Stays True
description: Break Effect score +3. An attacking Ultimate forces targets to make a Constitution save; failure gives +1 allied hit damage taken for 2 turns, or +2 if your total Break Effect bonus is at least +3.

name: See You at the End
description: Critical damage bonus +2. Skill and follow-up hits deal +2 damage.

name: Shadowburn
description: Your first memosprite summon in combat restores 1 SP and 3 Energy. Once per combat.

name: Shadowed By Night
description: Break Effect score +2. Combat start and your Breaks grant speed +10 feet for 2 turns. Break trigger limited to once per turn.

name: Shared Feeling
description: Outgoing healing +2. Your Skill restores 1 Energy to every ally, once per turn.

name: Shattered Home
description: Deal +2 damage against enemies above half maximum HP.

name: She Already Shut Her Eyes
description: Maximum HP +8 and Energy Regeneration score +2. Losing HP grants party damage +1 for 2 turns. At combat start, heal each ally for one quarter of their missing HP, rounded down, once per combat.

name: Sleep Like the Dead
description: Critical damage bonus +4. If a Basic or Skill attack misses a critical, critical threshold −2 until your next turn ends. Three-turn cooldown.

name: Sneering
description: During Aha's Instant, your Elation hits deal +2 damage.

name: Solitary Healing
description: Break Effect score +3. Your Ultimate grants a 2-turn window: DoTs you apply during it gain +1 turn. An enemy defeated while carrying your DoT restores 3 Energy, once per turn.

name: Something Irreplaceable
description: Attack bonus +2. Being hit or defeating an enemy restores 3 HP and grants damage +2 until your next turn ends. Combined limit: once per turn.

name: Subscribe for More!
description: Basic and Skill damage +1; increase this bonus to +2 while your Energy is full.

name: Sweat Now, Cry Less
description: Critical threshold −1. While your memosprite is present, you and it deal +2 damage.

name: Swordplay
description: Consecutive attacks against the same target grant damage +1 per stack, capped at +3. Gain one stack per attack after resolving it. Switching targets resets the stacks before damage.

name: Texture of Memories
description: Saving throws +1. Being hit without temporary HP grants 5 temporary HP lasting 2 turns, with a 3-turn cooldown. While you have temporary HP, reduce incoming damage by 1 per hit.

name: The Birth of the Self
description: Follow-up damage +2, increasing to +4 against enemies below half HP.

name: The Day The Cosmos Fell
description: Attack bonus +1. An attack hitting at least 2 targets weak to its element grants critical damage bonus +3 for 2 turns.

name: The Finale of a Lie
description: Critical threshold −1. At combat start and every fourth follow-up, gain attack bonus +2 for 3 turns and mark hit enemies: allied hits deal +1 damage for 3 turns. Refresh; do not stack.

name: The Flower Remembers
description: You and your memosprite gain critical damage bonus +3.

name: The Forever Victual
description: Attack bonus +1. Your Skill grants another +1 attack bonus per stack, maximum 2 additional stacks, for combat.

name: The Great Cosmic Enterprise
description: Attack bonus +1. Deal +1 damage per distinct weakness on the target, capped at +3.

name: The Hell Where Ideals Burn
description: Critical threshold −1. Party SP capacity +1. Your Skill grants attack bonus +1 per stack, capped at +3 for combat.

name: The Moles Welcome You
description: Your first Basic, Skill, and Ultimate each grant attack bonus +1 for combat. Maximum +3; each category contributes once.

name: The Seriousness of Breakfast
description: Deal +1 damage. Defeating an enemy grants attack bonus +1 per stack, capped at +3 for combat.

name: The Story's Next Page
description: Maximum HP +5. Your memosprite's attack grants outgoing healing +2 to you and it until your next turn.

name: The Unreachable Side
description: Critical threshold −1 and maximum HP +8. Being hit or spending HP charges your next attack for +3 damage. Only one charge can be stored.

name: This Is Me!
description: AC +1. Ultimate damage gains +1 per 2 AC above 10, capped at +3, once per target per Ultimate.

name: This Love, Forever
description: Speed +10 feet. A memosprite Skill supporting an ally marks enemies for +1 allied hit damage taken for 2 turns. An enemy-targeting memosprite Skill grants party critical damage bonus +2 for 2 turns. When both effects coexist, increase each bonus by 1.

name: Those Many Springs
description: Effect Hit bonus +2. Once per turn, a hit forces a Constitution save; failure marks the target for allied direct-hit damage taken +1 for 2 turns, increasing to +2 while it carries a tracked DoT sourced to you. No DoT damage bonus.

name: Though Worlds Apart
description: Attack bonus +2. Your Ultimate heals every ally for 3 HP and the lowest-HP-percentage ally for another 3 HP. Party damage +2 for 3 turns; summoned allies gain +3 instead.

name: Thus Burns the Dawn
description: Speed +10 feet and damage +2. Your Ultimate grants another damage +2 until your next turn starts.

name: Time Waits for No One
description: Maximum HP +8 and outgoing healing +2. Record actual HP restored by your healing. The next allied attack adds half that amount as damage, capped at +4; consume the record. One trigger per turn, latest healing replaces the record.

name: Time Woven Into Gold
description: Speed +10 feet. You or your memosprite attacking grants both critical damage bonus +1 per stack, capped at +6 for combat, once per turn. At 6 stacks, both gain Basic damage +2.

name: To Evernight's Stars
description: Maximum HP +8. Your memosprite's Skill grants all allied memosprites damage +2 and you and your sprite damage +2 for 2 turns; these two grants do not double-stack on your sprite. Its disappearance restores 3 Energy, once per turn.

name: Today Is Another Peaceful Day
description: Deal +1 damage per 20 maximum Energy, capped at +3.

name: Today's Good Luck
description: Critical threshold −1. Your Elation Skill grants Elation damage +1 per stack, capped at +2 for combat.

name: Tomorrow, Together
description: Critical damage bonus +2. Your Ultimate grants party Elation damage +2 until your next turn.

name: Trend of the Universal Market
description: AC +1. Once per turn, an attacker hitting you makes a Constitution save; failure applies Burn: 1d4 Fire damage for 2 target turns.

name: Under the Blue Sky
description: Attack bonus +1. Defeating an enemy grants critical threshold −1 for 3 turns.

name: Until the Flowers Bloom Again
description: Critical damage bonus +4 and Energy Regeneration score +2, increasing to +3 if maximum Energy is at least 60. Your Elation Skill forces a Constitution save; failure grants +2 allied hit damage taken for 2 turns.

name: Unto Tomorrow's Morrow
description: Outgoing healing +2. Allies above half maximum HP deal +1 damage while you are conscious in combat.

name: Victory In a Blink
description: Critical damage bonus +2. A memosprite ability supporting an ally grants party damage +1 for 3 turns.

name: Void
description: Effect Hit bonus +1 for your first 3 turns in combat.

name: Warmth Shortens Cold Nights
description: Maximum HP +5. A Basic or Skill restores 1 HP to every ally, once per turn.

name: We Are Wildfire
description: At combat start, allies reduce incoming damage by 1 per hit for 5 turns and recover one fifth of missing HP, rounded down. Once per combat; multiple copies do not stack.

name: We Will Meet Again
description: A Basic or Skill deals +2 damage to one randomly selected target it hit, once per turn.

name: Welcome to the Cosmic City
description: Speed +10 feet and Elation damage +2. Your Ultimate grants 3 Punchline, then locks this trigger until you have used 3 Basics. Ultimate-triggered Punchline cannot retrigger the same effect.

name: What Is Real?
description: Break Effect score +2. Your Basic restores 2 HP to you, once per turn.

name: When She Decided to See
description: Speed +10 feet. At combat start or after a support Ultimate, party critical threshold −1 and critical damage bonus +2, plus your Energy Regeneration score +2, for 3 turns. Start combat with 3 Energy for each ally.

name: Whereabouts Should Dreams Rest
description: Break Effect score +3. Your Break marks the target for Break damage taken +2 and speed −10 feet for 2 turns. Refresh, do not stack.

name: Why Does the Ocean Sing
description: Effect Hit bonus +2. Applying a debuff grants tracked Enthrall, capped at 3 stacks for 3 target turns. At 2 or more stacks, all allied-source DoTs on that target gain one die step while the mark lasts; cap d12. An allied direct hit grants that ally speed +5 feet for 3 turns, once per turn. Ends if you fall unconscious.

name: Woof! Walk Time!
description: Attack bonus +1. Direct hits deal +2 damage against tracked Burn or Bleed targets. Your Burn and Bleed DoTs gain +1 turn when applied.

name: Worrisome, Blissful
description: Critical threshold −1 and follow-up damage +2. Your follow-up grants Tame, capped at 2 stacks: allied critical hits against that target gain +1 critical damage per stack for 2 turns.

name: Yet Hope Is Priceless
description: Critical threshold −1. Your follow-ups gain +1 damage per 3 points of total critical damage bonus, capped at +3. At combat start and after a Basic, Ultimate and follow-up damage +2 for 2 turns.
